newsitem.title: GERMANY: BUNDESBANK KEEPS KEY INTEREST RATES ON HOLD.
newsitem.headline: BUNDESBANK KEEPS KEY INTEREST RATES ON HOLD.

text.p: The German central bank said its policy-making council held key interest rates steady at its meeting on Thursday.

The Bundesbank's discount rate remains at 2.50 percent and the Lombard emergency financing rate at 4.50 percent. The central bank's main money market rate, the repo, was also maintained at three percent for the next two weeks.

A Reuter survey of economists this week showed that none of the 10 polled expected any change in the central bank's credit policies and the German bond and share markets showed almost no response to the news.
